settings.performance.batchSizeHelp: The number of subscribers to pull from the database in a single iteration. Each iteration pulls subscribers from the database, sends messages to them, and then moves on to the next iteration to pull the next batch. This should ideally be higher than the maximum achievable throughput (concurrency * message_rate).
settings.performance.cacheSlowQueriesHel: Only enable this on large databases that have slowed down significantly. Caches list subscriber counts, dashboard statistics etc.
settings.performance.concurrencyHelp: Maximum concurrent worker (threads) that will attempt to send messages simultaneously.
settings.performance.maxErrThresholdHelp: The number of errors (eg: SMTP timeouts while e-mailing) a running campaign should tolerate before it is paused for manual investigation or intervention. Set to 0 to never pause.
settings.performance.messageRateHelp: Maximum number of messages to be sent out per second per worker in a second. If concurrency = 10 and message_rate = 10, then up to 10x10=100 messages may be pushed out every second. This, along with concurrency, should be tweaked to keep the net messages going out per second under the target message servers rate limits if any.

developers.webhooks.deleteText: It stops receiving events and its delivery history is removed.

developers.overview.title: Overview
developers.overview.intro: Send receipts, password resets and alerts from your own code through the transactional API.
developers.overview.stepKeyText: One key per service, with the tx:send scope.
developers.overview.stepKeyHelp: Keys authenticate your code. The secret is shown once, so keep it in your secrets manager.
developers.overview.stepTemplateText: The email your code sends, with variables for its data.
developers.overview.stepTemplateHelp: Templates use .Tx.Data for the data your code sends and .Subscriber for the recipient.
developers.overview.stepTestText: Call POST /api/tx from your code or the browser.
developers.overview.stepTestHelp: Run this with your key. The message appears in the log within seconds.
developers.overview.stepLogText: See delivery status and the exact payload.
developers.overview.stepLogHelp: Every message has a timeline from accepted to delivered or bounced.
auth.forgotHelp: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.setupHelp: Set a password for your account.

campaigns.confirm.running.title: Send “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.running.text: It goes out to {n} subscribers now. You can pause it while it sends.
campaigns.confirm.paused.title: Pause “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.paused.text: Sending stops after the messages already in flight. You can resume it later.
campaigns.confirm.scheduled.title: Schedule “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.scheduled.text: It sends automatically at its send time.
campaigns.confirm.draft.title: Unschedule “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.draft.text: It goes back to draft and won't send until you schedule or send it again.
campaigns.confirm.cancelled.title: Cancel “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.cancelled.text: Sending stops for good. Subscribers who haven't received it won't. This can't be undone.
campaigns.confirm.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
campaigns.confirm.delete.text: The campaign and its stats are removed. Emails already sent aren't affected.
campaigns.confirm.deleteMany.title: Delete {n} campaigns?
campaigns.confirm.deleteMany.text: They're removed with their stats. Emails already sent aren't affected.
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.formatInContent: Change the format in the Content step; switching converts the content.
campaigns.audienceHelp: subscribers across {n} list(s). Someone on several lists gets it once; blocklisted and unsubscribed are excluded.
campaigns.plainTextNone: Not set. Clients that can't show HTML get none.
campaigns.sendNowHelp: Starts as soon as you confirm on the review step.
campaigns.sendLaterHelp: Pick a date and time; it starts on its own.

campaigns.checkNoTest: No test sent from this page yet.
campaigns.checkPlainCustom: A custom plain-text version is set.
